turns.question: What can I do on a rainy day in Wakefield?
turns.reply:
For a rainy day, you could start with a museum or gallery:

[The Hepworth Wakefield](https://hepworthwakefield.org/your-visit/) · Art gallery.

[Wakefield Museum](https://museumsandcastles.wakefield.gov.uk/visit/wakefield-museum/plan-your-visit-to-wakefield-museum/) · Museum.

[Castleford Museum](https://museumsandcastles.wakefield.gov.uk/visit/castleford-museum/plan-your-visit-to-castleford-museum/) · Museum.

Check the official pages for opening days, admission and booking requirements.

What day and roughly what time are you visiting?

sources.title: The Hepworth Wakefield - official visit page

turns.question: Anything in the city centre with parking?
turns.reply:
For a rainy day in Wakefield city centre, start with Wakefield Museum and Wakefield Library, both at Wakefield One on Burton Street:

[Wakefield Library](https://www.wakefield.gov.uk/libraries-and-local-history/your-local-library/wakefield-library) · Public library.

[Wakefield Museum](https://museumsandcastles.wakefield.gov.uk/visit/wakefield-museum/plan-your-visit-to-wakefield-museum/) · Museum.

For parking, the museum’s visit guide names Merchant Gate as the nearest car park. [Check the Council’s Merchant Gate details](https://www.wakefield.gov.uk/roads-and-travel/parking/car-parks-across-the-district/merchant-gate-car-park) for its current terms. I haven’t checked live spaces, so availability is not guaranteed.

Check the official pages for opening days, admission and booking requirements.
